name: Old mage lineage
birthText: Your family's name is spoken carefully in the mage world. The crest on your crib is older than the house it hangs in.
description: Generations of refined Magic Crests, wealth, and enemies. Much is expected of you.

name: Minor mage family
birthText: Your parents are mages of modest standing: respected enough to be invited, not enough to be listened to.
description: A few generations of craft and a respectable workshop. You will have to earn the rest.

name: Fallen mage family
birthText: Your family once mattered. Now there is a mortgage on the ancestral house and a locked room nobody talks about.
description: The blood remains strong, but the money, the reputation and most of the secrets are gone.

name: Non-mage family
birthText: Your parents are ordinary people. As far as they know, magic is something from storybooks.
description: No crest, no workshop, no teacher. Whatever you learn about magic, you will have to find yourself.
